question: 'Chad Sukra', a popular traditional dance-festival of Meghalaya, is celebrated as a ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**sowing festival.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Chad Sukra**

 
 
• Chad Sukra', a popular traditional dance festival of Meghalaya, is celebrated as a **sowing festival**.
 
• The agricultural communities of the Jaintia people of Jowai, indicate the time for planting with the annual spring cultural festival called &am
